name: Complete Checkout with a Single Item (End-to-End Happy Path)
description: Verify a logged-in user can complete the full checkout flow (Cart → Checkout Info → Overview → Confirmation) for a single item.
precondition: Fresh browser context; SauceDemo available at https://www.saucedemo.com.

test_steps.description: Navigate to https://www.saucedemo.com and log in with `standard_user` / `secret_sauce`.
test_steps.expected_result: User is redirected to `/inventory.html` (Products page).

test_steps.description: Click "Add to cart" for Sauce Labs Backpack.
test_steps.expected_result: Cart badge shows "1"; button changes to "Remove".

test_steps.description: Click the cart icon to open the Cart page.
test_steps.expected_result: Cart page (`cart.html`) lists Sauce Labs Backpack with quantity 1, description, and price $29.99.

test_steps.description: Click "Checkout".
test_steps.expected_result: User is redirected to `/checkout-step-one.html` ("Checkout: Your Information").

test_steps.description: Enter First Name "Jane", Last Name "Smith", Zip "12345", click "Continue".
test_steps.expected_result: User is redirected to `/checkout-step-two.html` ("Checkout: Overview").

test_steps.description: Review the Overview page.
test_steps.expected_result: Sauce Labs Backpack line item (qty 1, $29.99) shown; Payment Information "SauceCard #31337"; Shipping Information "Free Pony Express Delivery!"; Item total $29.99, Tax $2.40 (8%), Total $32.39.

test_steps.description: Click "Finish".
test_steps.expected_result: User is redirected to `/checkout-complete.html`; heading "Thank you for your order!" displayed; cart badge shows empty.

test_steps.description: Click "Back Home".
test_steps.expected_result: User is redirected to `/inventory.html` (Products page).

name: Complete Checkout with Multiple Items and Verify Price Arithmetic
description: Verify multi-item checkout completes correctly and that subtotal/tax/total arithmetic on the Overview page is accurate.
precondition: Logged in as `standard_user`; fresh cart.

test_steps.description: Add Sauce Labs Backpack and Sauce Labs Bike Light to the cart.
test_steps.expected_result: Cart badge shows "2".

test_steps.description: Open the Cart page.
test_steps.expected_result: Both items are listed with quantity 1 each and correct individual prices.

test_steps.description: Click "Checkout", fill in valid First Name, Last Name, and Zip, click "Continue".
test_steps.expected_result: User reaches the Overview page listing both items.

test_steps.description: Read the "Item total", "Tax", and "Total" values on the Overview page.
Click "Finish".
test_steps.expected_result: Order completes successfully and cart is cleared.

name: Cart Page Displays Full Item Details for Each Product
description: Verify the Cart page displays name, description, price, and quantity for each added item.
precondition: Logged in as `standard_user`; Sauce Labs Backpack added to cart.

test_steps.description: Open the Cart page.
test_steps.expected_result: Item name "Sauce Labs Backpack" is visible; item description text is visible; item price "$29.99" is visible; item quantity "1" is visible.

name: Cart Page Offers Continue Shopping and Checkout Options
description: Verify the Cart page exposes both "Continue Shopping" and "Checkout" controls, and that "Continue Shopping" preserves cart state.
precondition: Logged in as `standard_user`; any item added to cart; Cart page open.

test_steps.description: Verify "Continue Shopping" and "Checkout" buttons on the Cart page.
test_steps.expected_result: Both buttons are visible and enabled.

test_steps.description: Click "Continue Shopping".
test_steps.expected_result: User is redirected to `/inventory.html`; cart badge count is unchanged (item still in cart).

name: [DEFECT] Cart Page Does Not Display a Total/Subtotal Price
description: Verify whether the Cart page displays a total/subtotal price calculation as required by FR2/AC1. Defect Status: Confirmed Defect — live exploration 2026-09-16 (see Structured Test Plan discrepancy #1).
precondition: Logged in as `standard_user`; two items with different prices added to cart.

test_steps.description: Open the Cart page and inspect for any subtotal/tax/total price element.
test_steps.expected_result: Expected (Per Requirement): The Cart page displays the total price calculation for all items in the cart (FR2, AC1). | Observed (Live Application): No subtotal, tax, or total price element is present anywhere on `cart.html` — only the two individual item prices are shown. Total/subtotal/tax only appear later, on the Overview page. | Step Status: Fail — Confirmed Defect. Flag as a requirement-vs-implementation gap for defect triage; do not silently skip.

name: Submitting an Entirely Empty Form Shows First Name Required Error First
description: Verify mandatory-field validation fires for First Name when the checkout information form is submitted entirely empty, and that the required form fields are present.
precondition: Logged in as `standard_user`; one item added to cart; user has clicked "Checkout" and is on `checkout-step-one.html`.

test_steps.description: Verify First Name, Last Name, and Zip/Postal Code fields are present on the page, then leave all three empty and click "Continue".
test_steps.expected_result: Fields for First Name, Last Name, and Zip/Postal Code are displayed (FR5). An error alert is shown reading "Error: First Name is required"; user remains on `checkout-step-one.html`.

name: Leaving Only Last Name Empty Shows Last Name Required Error
description: Verify mandatory-field validation fires specifically for Last Name when only that field is left empty.
precondition: On `checkout-step-one.html`.

test_steps.description: Enter First Name only, leave Last Name and Zip empty, click "Continue".
test_steps.expected_result: Error alert reads "Error: Last Name is required"; user remains on `checkout-step-one.html`.

name: Leaving Only Zip/Postal Code Empty Shows Postal Code Required Error
description: Verify mandatory-field validation fires specifically for Zip/Postal Code when only that field is left empty.
precondition: On `checkout-step-one.html`.

test_steps.description: Enter First Name and Last Name, leave Zip empty, click "Continue".
test_steps.expected_result: Error alert reads "Error: Postal Code is required"; user remains on `checkout-step-one.html`.

name: Valid First Name, Last Name, and Zip Proceed to Overview Page
description: Verify that submitting fully valid checkout information successfully advances the user to the Overview page with no error.
precondition: On `checkout-step-one.html`.

test_steps.description: Enter First Name "Jane", Last Name "Smith", Zip "12345", click "Continue".
test_steps.expected_result: User is redirected to `/checkout-step-two.html` with no error alert shown.

name: Error Alert Can Be Dismissed via Its Close Control
description: Verify the required-field error alert can be dismissed and that the form remains usable afterward.
precondition: On `checkout-step-one.html`.

test_steps.description: Click "Continue" with all fields empty to trigger the required-field error.
test_steps.expected_result: Error alert is visible.

test_steps.description: Click the "Dismiss error" (X) control on the alert.
test_steps.expected_result: The error alert is no longer visible; form fields remain empty and editable.

name: [DEFECT] Special Characters in Zip/Postal Code Are Accepted Without a Format Validation Error
description: Verify whether entering special characters in the Zip/Postal Code field is rejected with a validation error, per AC5/FR16/FR17. Defect Status: Confirmed Defect — live exploration 2026-09-16 (see Structured Test Plan discrepancy #2).
precondition: On `checkout-step-one.html`.

test_steps.description: Enter First Name "John", Last Name "Doe", Zip "!@#$%", click "Continue".
test_steps.expected_result: Expected (Per Requirement): A format-validation error is shown for the invalid Zip value; user cannot proceed until it is corrected (AC5, FR16, FR17). | Observed (Live Application): No format-validation error is shown; user is redirected to `/checkout-step-two.html` despite the non-numeric, special-character Zip value. | Step Status: Fail — Confirmed Defect. Contradicts AC5/FR16/FR17, which expect a validation error for invalid data such as special characters.

name: [DEFECT] Whitespace-Only First Name Is Accepted as Valid
description: Verify whether a First Name consisting only of whitespace is correctly rejected as a blank mandatory field. Defect Status: Confirmed Defect — live exploration 2026-09-16 (see Structured Test Plan discrepancy #2).
precondition: On `checkout-step-one.html`.

test_steps.description: Enter First Name as three spaces "   ", Last Name "Doe", Zip "12345", click "Continue".
test_steps.expected_result: Expected (Per Requirement): A "First Name is required" error is shown, since the field is effectively blank (FR6/FR7 mandatory-field enforcement; AC5 rejects incomplete information). | Observed (Live Application): No "First Name is required" error is shown; user is redirected to `/checkout-step-two.html`. | Step Status: Fail — Confirmed Defect. Contradicts the spirit of FR6/FR7 and AC5.

name: [DEFECT] Oversized Name Input and Special-Character Last Name Are Both Accepted
description: Verify whether an oversized First Name and a special-character/digit Last Name are rejected with length-limit or character-format validation errors. Defect Status: Confirmed Defect — live exploration 2026-09-16 (see Structured Test Plan discrepancy #2).
precondition: On `checkout-step-one.html`.

test_steps.description: Enter a First Name of 90+ characters, a Last Name containing digits and special characters ("Doe123!@#"), and a valid Zip, then click "Continue".
test_steps.expected_result: Expected (Per Requirement): A length-limit or character-format error is shown for one or both fields (AC5, FR16, FR17). | Observed (Live Application): No length-limit or character-format error is shown for either field; user is redirected to `/checkout-step-two.html`. | Step Status: Fail — Confirmed Defect. Confirms no max-length or allowed-character validation exists, contradicting the intent of AC5/FR16/FR17.

name: Numeric 5-Digit Zip/Postal Code Is Accepted (Happy-Path Boundary)
description: Verify a well-formed 5-digit numeric Zip/Postal Code is accepted without error, as a boundary/control case against the negative scenarios above.
precondition: On `checkout-step-one.html`.

test_steps.description: Enter valid First Name and Last Name, enter Zip "99999", click "Continue".
test_steps.expected_result: User is redirected to `/checkout-step-two.html` with no errors.

name: Overview Page Lists All Cart Items with Correct Details
description: Verify the Overview page correctly summarizes all items carried over from the cart, as a read-only summary.
precondition: Logged in; Sauce Labs Backpack and Sauce Labs Bike Light added to cart; valid checkout information submitted; user is on `checkout-step-two.html`.

test_steps.description: Review the Overview page item list.
test_steps.expected_result: Both items are listed with correct name, quantity (1 each), and price; no "Add to cart" / "Remove" controls are shown on this read-only summary.

name: Overview Page Displays Payment and Shipping Information Sections
description: Verify Payment Information and Shipping Information sections render on the Overview page (per Assumption A3, this is static demo data, not user-entered).
precondition: User is on `checkout-step-two.html` with at least one item in the cart.

test_steps.description: Inspect the Payment Information and Shipping Information sections.
test_steps.expected_result: "Payment Information:" section shows "SauceCard #31337"; "Shipping Information:" section shows "Free Pony Express Delivery!".

name: Overview Page Provides Cancel and Finish Controls
description: Verify both "Cancel" and "Finish" controls are present and enabled on the Overview page.
precondition: User is on `checkout-step-two.html` with at least one item in the cart.

test_steps.description: Verify the Overview page controls.
test_steps.expected_result: "Cancel" button is visible and enabled; "Finish" button is visible and enabled.

name: Finish Redirects to Confirmation Page with Success Message
description: Verify clicking "Finish" completes the order and displays the confirmation page with a success message and navigation option.
precondition: Checkout information completed; user is on `checkout-step-two.html` with at least one item.

test_steps.description: Click "Finish".
test_steps.expected_result: User is redirected to `/checkout-complete.html`; heading "Thank you for your order!" is displayed; descriptive dispatch/delivery text is displayed; "Back Home" button is visible.

name: Back Home Button Returns to the Products Page
description: Verify "Back Home" on the confirmation page correctly returns the user to the Products page.
precondition: User is on `checkout-complete.html` (order just completed).

test_steps.description: Click "Back Home".
test_steps.expected_result: User is redirected to `/inventory.html` (Products page); product grid is displayed.

name: Cart Is Cleared After Order Confirmation
description: Verify the cart is fully cleared (badge and contents) after an order is completed.
precondition: Logged in as `standard_user`.

test_steps.description: Add two items to the cart, complete checkout through "Finish" to reach `checkout-complete.html`.
test_steps.expected_result: Cart icon shows no item count badge ("Cart, empty").

test_steps.description: Open the Cart page directly.
test_steps.expected_result: Cart page shows zero line items.

name: Unauthenticated Direct Access to Checkout Is Blocked and Redirected to Login
description: Verify direct URL access to the checkout information page is blocked for unauthenticated users.
precondition: Not logged in (fresh context, or explicitly logged out via the hamburger menu "Logout" link).

test_steps.description: Without logging in (or after explicitly logging out), navigate directly to `https://www.saucedemo.com/checkout-step-one.html`.
test_steps.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page ("/"); an error alert is shown reading: "Epic sadface: You can only access '/checkout-step-one.html' when you are logged in."

name: [DEFECT] Checking Out with an Empty Cart Is Not Blocked and Can Be Completed with a $0.00 Total
description: Verify whether the application blocks a user from checking out with zero items in the cart, per BR3/FR19. Defect Status: Confirmed Defect — live exploration 2026-09-16 (see Structured Test Plan discrepancy #3).
precondition: Logged in as `standard_user` with a guaranteed-empty cart (e.g., immediately after fresh login, or after completing/clearing a prior order).

test_steps.description: Open the Cart page with zero items.
test_steps.expected_result: Expected (Per Requirement): "Checkout" should be disabled, hidden, or otherwise prevent proceeding when the cart is empty (BR3, FR19). | Observed (Live Application): "Checkout" button is present and enabled even though the cart has zero items. | Step Status: Fail — Confirmed Defect.

test_steps.description: Click "Checkout".
test_steps.expected_result: Expected (Per Requirement): User should be blocked from reaching `checkout-step-one.html`, or shown an empty-cart message. | Observed (Live Application): User is unexpectedly redirected to `/checkout-step-one.html`. | Step Status: Fail — Confirmed Defect.

test_steps.description: Fill in valid First Name, Last Name, and Zip, then click "Continue".
test_steps.expected_result: Expected (Per Requirement): This step should be unreachable per BR3/FR19. | Observed (Live Application): User reaches `/checkout-step-two.html` showing "Item total: $0", "Tax: $0.00", "Total: $0.00", and no line items. | Step Status: Fail — Confirmed Defect.

test_steps.description: Click "Finish".
test_steps.expected_result: Expected (Per Requirement): An order with zero items should not be completable. | Observed (Live Application): Order completes successfully and `/checkout-complete.html` is shown, confirming an order with zero items was allowed end-to-end. | Step Status: Fail — Confirmed Defect. Flag as a confirmed defect against BR3/FR19 for triage.

name: Logged-In Session Persists Across Checkout Steps for a Valid Multi-Step Flow
description: Verify no re-authentication is required as the user progresses through all four checkout steps in one continuous session.
precondition: Logged in as `standard_user`.

test_steps.description: Add an item, and progress through Cart → Checkout Info → Overview → Complete without logging out.
test_steps.expected_result: No re-authentication is required at any step; each page transition succeeds without redirect to login.

name: [DEFECT] Attempting to Check Out Again Immediately After Order Completion Reproduces the Same Empty-Cart Defect
description: Verify whether the TC-022 empty-cart-checkout defect is a one-off or a consistently reproducible gap, by immediately re-attempting checkout on a freshly emptied cart. Defect Status: Confirmed Defect (repeatable) — live exploration 2026-09-16 (see Structured Test Plan discrepancy #3).
precondition: One item added to cart; a full order has just been completed so the cart is now empty.

test_steps.description: From the now-empty cart page, click "Checkout" again.
test_steps.expected_result: Expected (Per Requirement): The application should block checkout or show a "cart is empty" guard message (BR3, FR19). | Observed (Live Application): The application again allows navigation to `checkout-step-one.html` despite zero items, reproducing the BR3/FR19 gap rather than showing any guard message. | Step Status: Fail — Confirmed Defect (regression-confirmed, repeatable).

name: Cancel from Checkout Information Page Returns to Cart Page with Items Preserved
description: Verify Cancel on the Checkout Information page returns the user to the Cart page without losing cart contents.
precondition: Logged in; two items added to cart; user has clicked "Checkout" and is on `checkout-step-one.html`.

test_steps.description: Click "Cancel" on the Checkout Information page.
test_steps.expected_result: User is redirected to `/cart.html` (Your Cart); both items are still present in the cart with correct quantities and prices.

name: [DEFECT] Cancel from Checkout Overview Page Returns to Products Page, Not the Cart Page
description: Verify whether Cancel on the Overview page returns to the Cart page consistently with the step-one Cancel behavior (per BR5's implied "return to cart" intent). Defect Status: Confirmed Defect — live exploration 2026-09-16 (see Structured Test Plan discrepancy #4).
precondition: Logged in; two items added to cart; valid checkout information submitted; user is on `checkout-step-two.html`.

test_steps.description: Click "Cancel" on the Checkout Overview page.
test_steps.expected_result: Expected (Per Requirement): User is redirected to `/cart.html`, consistent with the step-one Cancel destination and the "return to cart" intent implied by BR5. | Observed (Live Application): User is redirected to `/inventory.html` (Products page), NOT `/cart.html`. Cart badge still shows the original item count, confirming cart contents are preserved even though the landing page differs. | Step Status: Fail — Confirmed Defect. Inconsistent with the step-one Cancel destination; flag as a UX/navigation defect for triage, not a data-loss defect (contents are preserved).

name: Browser Back Button After Order Confirmation Shows a Stale Overview Page Whose Finish Button Is Still Clickable
description: Verify what happens when the browser Back button is used after reaching the order confirmation page, and whether the stale Overview page can be used to re-submit the order. Known-Issue Status: Recorded as an informational finding per the Structured Test Plan's discrepancy log (item 8). Not one of the 7 scenarios explicitly designated for the strict Expected/Observed defect split, but the observed behavior is confirmed live-application behavior and should be flagged for defect triage rather than asserted pass/fail against an undocumented requirement (OQ6 is unresolved).
precondition: One item added to cart; a full order has just been completed to reach `checkout-complete.html`.

test_steps.description: Click the browser Back button.
test_steps.expected_result: Browser navigates to `/checkout-step-two.html` showing an empty/zero-value order summary (cart already cleared); "Finish" button is still present and enabled.

test_steps.description: Click "Finish" again.
test_steps.expected_result: User is redirected back to `/checkout-complete.html` without any error, confirming no safeguard exists against re-submitting/re-visiting a completed order via back navigation. Record as a known issue for defect triage — no documented requirement defines correct behavior here (OQ6).

name: Full Checkout Flow Renders and Completes at a Mobile Viewport (375x667)
description: Verify the entire checkout flow is usable and completable at a mobile viewport with no blocking layout issues.
precondition: Browser viewport set to 375x667 (e.g., iPhone SE dimensions).

test_steps.description: Set the browser viewport to 375x667 and log in as `standard_user`.
test_steps.expected_result: Login form and hamburger menu icon render without horizontal overflow.

test_steps.description: Add an item to the cart and proceed through Cart → Checkout Info → Overview → Complete at this viewport.
test_steps.expected_result: All buttons and form fields remain visible, tappable, and functional at each step; no layout element is clipped or overlapping such that a user could not complete checkout.

name: All Checkout-Flow Validation and Success Messages Are Captured for Content Review
description: Verify the exact wording of every mandatory-field validation message and the order-confirmation success message, so all messages are formally documented and regression-checkable.
precondition: Access to trigger each validation state and the confirmation page.

test_steps.description: Trigger each of: First Name required, Last Name required, Postal Code required, and the order-confirmation success message, capturing the exact text of each.
test_steps.expected_result: Messages match verbatim: "Error: First Name is required"; "Error: Last Name is required"; "Error: Postal Code is required"; "Thank you for your order!" success heading on `checkout-complete.html". All messages are recorded verbatim per NFR5.

name: [SUPPLEMENTAL] Cross-Browser Execution of the Smoke Checkout Flow
description: Verify the full checkout happy path (TC-001) behaves identically across the three browsers named in NFR1. This test case is added to ensure NFR1 is not left completely untested, since the current test plan does not include a dedicated cross-browser scenario.
precondition: Access to Chrome, Firefox, and Safari (or Playwright-equivalent engines: Chromium, Firefox, WebKit).

test_steps.description: Execute the TC-001 happy-path checkout flow on Chrome.
test_steps.expected_result: Full checkout flow completes with identical behavior/results to the Chrome baseline in TC-001.

test_steps.description: Execute the TC-001 happy-path checkout flow on Firefox.
test_steps.expected_result: Full checkout flow completes with identical behavior/results.

test_steps.description: Execute the TC-001 happy-path checkout flow on Safari/WebKit.
test_steps.expected_result: Full checkout flow completes with identical behavior/results.

name: [SUPPLEMENTAL] Exploratory Review of "Secure" and "Intuitive" Checkout Qualities
description: Exploratory pass to record observations about checkout "security" and "intuitiveness"/"clear feedback", since neither NFR has a measurable, testable acceptance threshold (OQ3, and the report's Note under Non-Functional Requirements). Findings only — not asserted as pass/fail against an undocumented standard.
precondition: Logged in as `standard_user`.

test_steps.description: Perform the full checkout flow while observing for any exposed sensitive data, non-HTTPS transitions, or session-handling concerns.
test_steps.expected_result: Observations recorded as findings; no pass/fail threshold is defined (NFR3, OQ3).

test_steps.description: Perform the full checkout flow while assessing clarity of feedback/messaging at each step.
test_steps.expected_result: Observations recorded as findings against NFR4 ("intuitive", "clear feedback"); no measurable threshold is defined.
